headerDisplay: Tuya cloud devices for HomeKit and optional Matter. Configure your own cloud project and linked app account before starting the plugin.

name.title: Name
name.description: You shouldn't need to change this.

username.title: App account
username.description: The Tuya Smart or Smart Life account linked to your cloud project.

accessId.title: Access ID
accessId.description: The Access ID / Client ID of your Tuya cloud project.

accessKey.title: Access Secret
accessKey.description: The Access Secret / Client Secret of your Tuya cloud project.

lang.title: Language Code
lang.description: Two-letter language code used in Tuya API requests, for example en or zh.

projectType.title: Project Type
projectType.description: PaaS requires app schema and country code. Custom projects require an HTTPS endpoint.

endPoint.title: Custom project endpoint
endPoint.description: Required only when Project Type is Custom (1). Enter your cloud project's HTTPS API endpoint, for example https://openapi.tuyaus.com. Leave blank for PaaS, which chooses its endpoint from the account country code.

appSchema.title: PaaS app
appSchema.description: Required for Smart Home PaaS (2). Choose the app containing your linked account and devices; unused for Custom projects.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: Required for Smart Home PaaS (2). Enter the dialing code for your app account's country, such as 1, 44 or 86; unused for Custom projects.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: Enable diagnostic logging when investigating a problem. Review logs before sharing them.

listDeviceId.title: List device IDs
listDeviceId.description: Print discovered device IDs and names to help configure exclusions or driver overrides. Device identifiers may be private; disable after use.

disabledDevice.title: Excluded devices
disabledDevice.description: Devices with these Tuya IDs are not added to HomeKit or Matter.

accessoryType.title: Device driver overrides
accessoryType.description: Override the driver only when the detected Tuya category is incorrect. Supported capabilities depend on the selected driver and the device's actual datapoints.
